For [misc](/docs/shell/commands/categories/misc/).

<div class='command-title'>Run the tutorial. To begin, run: tutor.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> tutor {flags} (search)```

## Flags

 -  `--find, -f {string}`: Search tutorial for a phrase.

## Parameters

 -  `search`: Item to search for, or 'list' to list available tutorials.


## Input/output types:

| input   | output |
| ------- | ------ |
| nothing | string |
## Examples

Begin the tutorial.
```nu
> tutor begin

```

Search a tutorial by phrase.
```nu
> tutor --find "$in"

```
